notes.title: “Caught up… to meet the Lord in the air”
notes.intro: Paul describes believers, living and dead, meeting the Lord at his coming.

views.label: A rapture of the church before a time of tribulation
views.summary: Many Pentecostals and some evangelicals expect believers to be taken up to meet Christ before a final tribulation and his visible return.
views.source: Assemblies of God, Statement of Fundamental Truths, 13

views.label: Part of one visible return of Christ
views.summary: Most Christians read this as believers going out to welcome Christ at his single, visible return, as citizens welcomed a visiting king.
views.source: Catechism of the Catholic Church 1001; Augsburg Confession, Article XVII
